Variation -- Possible Errors E_OK E_NOT_OK E_BUSY Operation GetRxFreshnessAuthData Comment This interface is used by the SecOC to obtain the current freshness value. This operation provides also a part of the Authentic-PDU data if configured. StbMTruncatedFreshness ValueLength Holds the length in bits of the truncated freshness value. Parameters (in) StbMAuthVerifyAttempts Holds the number of authentication verify attempts of this time sync message since the last reception.
